description: Process-launch coverage manifest (SX-2476). Every OS-process launch in production code is listed here with how it stays in an agent scope, or why it may stay outside. Regenerate site counts with `pnpm check:process-launches --write`; classes and reasons are edited by hand.

launch-primitive.summary: Implements the shared launch contract; the only place a plain Node call may sit behind the setting-off branch.

contained-root.summary: Starts a root process and hands the launch to the shared primitive (or is given a scoped launch root).

contained-descendant.summary: Runs only inside a process that is already in an agent scope, so it inherits the scope.

control-plane-exempt.summary: Control-plane work that stays in the server cgroup by design. The exemption kind says why.

test-support.summary: Reached only from tests, evals or mock cores; never from a production run.

exemptions.host-lookup: Short fixed-argument lookups of host or process facts.
exemptions.operator-cli: Commands that run in the operator's own shell or browser.
exemptions.bounded-host-helper: A fixed host helper with size and time limits.
exemptions.dev-support: Developer, eval or experimental-lab tooling that runs no agent code.

cli/src/client/board-auth.ts.reason: Opens the board sign-in URL in the operator's browser. It runs in the operator's own shell, outside the server.

cli/src/commands/channels.ts.reason: Runs operator-requested channel setup commands from the operator's shell. It runs in the operator's own shell, outside the server.

cli/src/commands/git-workspace.ts.reason: Reads git facts for the operator's current directory. It runs in the operator's own shell, outside the server.

cli/src/commands/install.ts.reason: Runs the operator's install steps from their shell. It runs in the operator's own shell, outside the server.

cli/src/commands/run.ts.reason: Builds workspace dependencies for the operator's dev run. It runs in the operator's own shell, outside the server.

cli/src/commands/runtime.ts.reason: Installs agent runtimes the operator asks for. It runs in the operator's own shell, outside the server.

cli/src/commands/update.ts.reason: Runs the operator's package manager to update the install. It runs in the operator's own shell, outside the server.

cli/src/commands/worktree.ts.reason: Runs git and package-manager steps for worktree commands. It runs in the operator's own shell, outside the server.

cli/src/config/server-bind.ts.reason: Asks tailscale for the host address when configuring the bind. It runs in the operator's own shell, outside the server.

cli/src/services/service-manager.ts.reason: Runs systemctl and launchctl for the operator's service commands. It runs in the operator's own shell, outside the server.

packages/adapter-utils/src/acpx-engine/e.reason: The patched acpx spawnAgent hook starts the ACP agent through the shared scoped spawn; the gemini version probe uses execFileAuxiliary.

packages/adapter-utils/src/execution-tar.reason: Generated programs run on the remote target; host-side launches go through runChildProcess.

packages/adapter-utils/src/github-launch.reason: Generated launcher text: runs as a child of an already scoped provider root and spawns plain, so descendants inherit the scope.

packages/adapter-utils/src/local-process.reason: Generated network proxy bridge: runs inside the sandboxed, already scoped command and spawns plain.

packages/adapter-utils/src/process-isola.reason: Policy-aware spawn used by the scoped wrappers; the plain branch is the setting-off path.

packages/adapter-utils/src/scoped-proces.reason: Shared spawn, execFile and spawnSync wrappers: each launch is handed to the scope helper when the instance setting is on, and is a plain Node call only when it is off.

packages/adapter-utils/src/test-support/.reason: Live systemd isolation fixture used by tests to read cgroups and stop slices.
Test harness that runs a command to prove MCP launches stay in the scope.

packages/db/src/backup-lib.ts.reason: Runs pg_dump and psql against the Paperclip database; this is control-plane data work and must stay with the server.

packages/db/src/migration-runtime.ts.reason: Loads and starts the embedded Postgres that the server depends on; it stays in the server cgroup by design.

packages/db/src/test-embedded-postgres.t.reason: Starts a throwaway embedded Postgres for tests; imported only by test files.

packages/paperclip-runner/src/control-pl.reason: spawnRunner is passed the scoped launch root, so each runner process starts inside its own agent scope.

packages/paperclip-runner/src/drivers/ac.reason: Directory sync helper runs in the runner process, which is itself in an agent scope.
The patched acpx spawnAgent hook is set to the scoped launch root, so acpx never uses its own spawn fallback here.
The verified ACP guardian is started through the scoped launch root; the embedded guardian program only spawns descendants of that root.
Generated native bootstrap runs inside the contained ACP guardian and spawns plain.

packages/paperclip-runner/src/drivers/co.reason: The Codex app-server child is started through the scoped launch root when the driver runs directly.
Git trust setup runs in the runner process, which is itself in an agent scope.

packages/paperclip-runner/src/drivers/op.reason: The OpenCode server child is started through the scoped launch root and keeps its executable descriptor.

packages/paperclip-runner/src/evals/runn.reason: Offline artifact verification used by evals and builds; not reachable from a run.

packages/paperclip-runner/src/live/linux.reason: Reads a process start time with ps for identity checks; fixed arguments, no workload.

packages/paperclip-runner/src/live/runne.reason: Reads a process start time with ps for identity checks; fixed arguments, no workload.

packages/paperclip-runner/src/mock-core/.reason: Mock core controller that starts a local fake runner for tests and demos only.

packages/paperclip-runner/src/process-is.reason: Runner-side wrapper that starts a runner or provider root through the scope helper when the trusted policy says so.

packages/paperclip-runner/src/providers/.reason: Grok provider launcher: it replaces itself with the provider (execve) inside the contained guardian.

packages/plugins/create-paperclip-plugin.reason: Scaffolding tool run by a developer on their own machine to pack a local package.

packages/plugins/examples/plugin-kitchen.reason: Example plugin worker code; runs inside the plugin worker scope.

packages/plugins/paperclip-plugin-fake-s.reason: Plugin worker code for the fake sandbox provider; runs inside the plugin worker scope.

packages/plugins/plugin-workspace-diff/s.reason: Plugin worker code: runs git inside the plugin worker, which plugin-worker-manager starts in a scope.

packages/plugins/sandbox-providers/dayto.reason: Plugin worker code: tar helpers run inside the plugin worker scope.

packages/plugins/sandbox-providers/exe-d.reason: Plugin worker code: the ssh client runs inside the plugin worker scope.

packages/plugins/sandbox-providers/kuber.reason: Plugin worker code: tar helpers run inside the plugin worker scope.

packages/process-launch/src/capability.t.reason: Capability probe: runs busctl with a bounded timeout to ask the user manager whether scopes can be created; it launches no workload.

packages/process-launch/src/launch.ts.reason: The process-launch primitive: spawns the paperclip-scope-exec helper that joins a transient scope before it execs the target.

packages/process-launch/src/systemd-test.reason: Builds and probes the helper for live systemd tests; imported only by test files.

packages/shared/src/worktree-port-regist.reason: Reads ps to see whether a recorded port owner is still alive; fixed arguments, no workload.

packages/tailscale-https-broker/src/tail.reason: Calls the host tailscale CLI with fixed arguments to read or set up tailnet exposure; no agent input reaches the command.

server/src/config.ts.reason: Asks the tailscale CLI for the host address at startup to choose a bind address; fixed arguments and a short timeout.

server/src/index.ts.reason: Opens the board URL in the operator's browser through the open package on a local start; not a workload.

server/src/instrumentation.ts.reason: Reads the server's own git revision or branch for display; short fixed-argument lookup.

server/src/server-info.ts.reason: Reads the server's own git revision or branch for display; short fixed-argument lookup.

server/src/services/agent-directory-prob.reason: The local agent directory probe runs inside an auxiliary scope when the setting is on and is a plain execFile only when it is off.

server/src/services/connectors/slack/eva.reason: Offline Slack regression script run by developers; not reachable from the server.

server/src/services/hot-restart.ts.reason: Runs the operator-approved restart command for the server itself; it must stay outside agent scopes so a restart can finish.

server/src/services/local-service-superv.reason: Reads ps and lsof facts to identify a local service that the server already owns; it starts no workload.

server/src/services/native-runtime/nativ.reason: The native Codex runner is spawned from the launch root built by createNativeLaunchRoots.
Server-side wrapper that creates the launch roots handed to a native runner coordinator.
Looks up the path of a file the server opened; short bounded lookup that runs no workload code.

server/src/services/photon/media.ts.reason: Converts one HEIF image through a fixed host helper with a size and time limit; no agent-chosen command.

server/src/services/plugin-worker-manage.reason: A plugin worker is forked only when isolation is off; with the setting on it is started through spawnScoped with the IPC descriptor preserved.

server/src/services/runtime-exposure/tai.reason: Calls the host tailscale CLI with fixed arguments to read or set up tailnet exposure; no agent input reaches the command.

server/src/services/smoke-lab.ts.reason: Experimental smoke lab (enableSmokeLab, private deployments only) starts its own fixture HTTP sidecar; it runs no agent or adapter code.

server/src/services/systemd-notify.ts.reason: Sends sd_notify readiness and watchdog messages to the service manager; it is host control, not agent workload.

server/src/version.ts.reason: Reads the server's own git revision or branch for display; short fixed-argument lookup.

The runner supervisor builds provider commands inside the runner process, which is itself in an agent scope; each provider keeps its own process group.

packages/process-launch/helper/src/main..reason: The helper's single final exec of the target after the scope is joined or the fallback is chosen.
